view.name: Battlefield – player's turn
view.description: Hex battlefield in round 8 with summoned creatures, the turn queue along the bottom, the active Swampler's ability buttons on the left, game controls on the right and the combat log.

regions.label: Dark textured decorative strip above the battlefield
Canvas showing a desert hex battlefield with creatures, HP number plates, red hex highlights and floating combat text
Vertical stack of square icon buttons (music, delay/fast-forward, skip-turn hourglass, fullscreen) with a purple energy meter on the edge
Collapsed, rounded translucent bar with a timestamped log line: 'Active Creature: Uncle Fungus'
Active-unit portrait plus the turn-order queue of creature portraits, each with a status/HP label and a 'Round 4' divider
Player info panel: Player1, 1 Points, 42 Plasma, 3 / 4 Units, Ancient Beast

evidence.note: Shows the latest entry of a timestamped combat log. The accessibility tree holds the full history: rounds, abilities used, damage taken.
HP number plates attached to each creature, framed in red or blue for the team
Status or HP labels under the queue portraits (Queued, Sickened, Protected, 26/37)
The turn-order queue orders agents, not the stages of a process. Proposed as turn-order-queue.
The player panel is a list of game resources, not a KPI tile
Floating combat text drawn over units is in-game feedback, not a toast

structure.layout: full-viewport game canvas with a HUD: bottom-left turn queue, bottom-center log bar, right-edge icon toolbar and player panel

aesthetics.typography: Play (techno sans) for all HUD text, combat text and log lines
aesthetics.typeScale: Small HUD type: 14px queue labels, 18px log text, 12px player stats. Floating combat text is larger, bold and yellow with an outline.

notes: Canvas-rendered tactics game (Phaser). Most of the UI is pixels on a canvas; the DOM holds only the HUD. The hex-grid battlefield and turn-order queue have no codebook entries, so I filed both as proposals (game-board, turn-order-queue). Team colours: red frames for one side and blue for the other, on both the unit HP plates and the queue portraits. Status labels have tinted backgrounds: olive for Sickened, gold for Protected, slate for Queued. The log bar is a rounded translucent pill with an italic timestamp and the creature name in blue. The right toolbar uses large painted-metal square icon buttons. A dark textured stone border frames the canvas top and bottom. On a fresh load, the live page shows a loading splash with a red ornate progress bar.
